title: Replies to every customer turn, whether or not the reply is a question

turns.text: Hi, my bathroom extractor fan has stopped working, can you sort it?
It's a ceiling fan, about four inch. The light still works but the fan is dead.

expect.note: a statement, not a question: still expects a reply

turns.text: Ok thanks, that all makes sense.

expect.note: an acknowledgement from the customer still gets something back
